description: A pin is read off what a binding was declared as, never off a narrowing of it: `value` reads `string` at the call and holds a `Bag` by the time it runs, because a closure wrote it and the checker kept the narrowing anyway — so the `let` keeps its floor. The `const` beside it discharges, since nothing can write one and its narrowing is the whole truth.

diagnostics.message: Call to `beginsWith` escapes this `@nothrow` function: it is non-throwing given `value.startsWith`, and the argument passed for it is a `let`, whose value the engine does not yet track across assignments. `beginsWith` enters `value.startsWith` at src/index.ts:7. Your outs, in precedence order: bridge this call with `try`/`catch`; assert the color in `nothrow.overrides.json`; install or write an `@no-throw/*` overlay; or, if you own the package, ship a manifest with `nothrow emit`.
